summary: @or-sdk/store preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` at install time. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (string-array rotator `WV8StW` over array `n7gIxM`, custom `hc1jfK9` decoder, `_0xXXXX`-style identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose filename does not match any advertised SDK function and whose contents are opaque. `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifiers and per-function string-lookup maps hiding URL parts, filenames, and command names. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the payload executes under a freshly-fetched non-Node runtime at `npm install` time, evading Node-scoped install scanners, and the payload's actual behavior is hidden behind heavy obfuscation. The package advertises itself as a store SDK, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an obfuscated 700KB blob at install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
